🧴 SPECIAL MATERIAL REQUEST
Search client → Select future appointment → Select therapy plan → Add stock
🔍 Step 1 — Search Client
ℹ️
How to Search
Type at least 3 letters of the client name OR 5 digits of the phone number. Matching clients will appear in the dropdown.
🔍
📅 Step 2 — Select Future Appointment
0 available
ℹ️
A future appointment is mandatory
Only active appointments belonging to the selected client are shown. The request cannot be submitted without selecting one.
Select the appointment for which this material will be used. Appointments already linked to a non-rejected Material Request are hidden.
💉 Step 3 — Select Therapy Plans & Add Stock 0 plans selected
💡 First select the future appointment. Then click + STOCK REQUEST on the matching paid therapy row, choose the consumable item, and enter quantity. You can add the required different stock items for the selected therapy service.
📝 Step 4 — Remarks & Treatment Card Upload
📎 Treatment Card Uploads (Camera / Photo)
📷 Upload treatment card photos — Treatment Record Cover Page and Consent Form are mandatory. Treatment Execution Page 1 becomes mandatory only when the client already has a recorded Therapy Session. Use camera to capture or upload scanned images. Up to 15 pages max.
🏬 Source & Target Warehouse
Fixed source warehouse: HO Main Stores.
Requested stock will be delivered to this warehouse.
Date by which the branch requires the material.
Source and Target Warehouse must be different. Only therapy services containing selected consumable items will be included.
✅ Submit For Approval
📋 ADVANCE BOOKING MATERIAL REQUEST
Pre-book material for an expected new joining client
👤 Step 1 — Expected Client Details
📋
ADVANCE BOOKING MATERIAL REQUEST
Use this when a new client is expected to join and you want to ensure stock is ready for their first treatment session. Sales cluster head approval is required before submission.
❓ Is this an Existing LIFE Client?
Yes — Existing LIFE Client (previously registered)
No — New / Fresh Client
Yes — Recent Walk-In Client (visited branch)
No — Completely new, not yet visited
📦 Step 2 — Material Required for Treatment
💡 Search and add the consumable stock items needed for the expected treatment. Add as many different items as required and enter the required quantity for each item.
🔍
📝 Step 3 — Remarks & Approvals
🔍
Only active Healthcare Practitioners with designation Area Manager, Area Manager (Trainee), or BDH are shown.
Already obtained approval from Sales Cluster Head named above*
📎 Attachments *
📷 Capture or upload all three mandatory expected-client documents below. Additional supporting images are optional. Up to 15 images can be attached.
🏬 Source & Target Warehouse
Fixed source warehouse: Stores - LSACPL.
Defaults to the logged-in employee's branch warehouse when available.
Source and Target Warehouse must be different.
